identity: University College Roosevelt, Liberal Arts & Sciences, 2026–27

sources.scope: Official curriculum summary: 180 credits, advanced alternatives, portfolio and award rules.
Six clusters, course levels and the purpose of gateway courses.
Business cluster interests, including market policy and sustainable entrepreneurship.
Data Science cluster interests, including computation, data, mathematics and cross-cluster questions.
Environment cluster interests, climate, biodiversity, pollution and coastal adaptation.
Government cluster interests, law, institutions, history, politics, philosophy and society.
Health cluster interests, cognition, psychology, biomedical and life science.
Media cluster interests, storytelling, representation, heritage and changing technology.
Illustrative pathways within the one Liberal Arts and Sciences degree and the basis of the interdisciplinary directions.
Controlling 2026–2027 Education and Examination Regulations, arts. 3.1, 3.3, 3.5, 3.6, 4.1, 4.2 and 6.3.
Liberal Arts & Sciences Portfolio, reflective development and collection of work.

curriculum: The Education and Examination Regulations establish an English-taught 180 EC degree. Articles 3.5 and 3.6 require ACCPPDE101 before semester three, 45 EC of advanced work, and a passed LAS Portfolio and Reflection. The portfolio is separate from the course-credit total. Article 4.1 gives 7.5 EC per regular course and 15 EC for a Research Seminar. The two advanced options are six regular 300-level courses or four plus a Research Seminar taken in or after semester five. Article 6.3 awards a BSc for 90 EC across the three science clusters combined including at least 22.5 EC of advanced courses in those clusters. A cluster-specific major requires 75 EC in that cluster including 22.5 EC at 300 level. The generic comparator allows both awards and does not prescribe a disciplinary route. The minimum course credit allocation is 7.5 EC development, 45 EC advanced, and 127.5 EC further choice, which can include additional advanced courses.
progression: The official cumulative milestones are 30, 60, 90, 120, 150 and 180 EC. Each example reaches them with four 7.5 EC courses per semester, takes development before semester three and meets the advanced requirement with regular courses. The broad example includes ten advanced courses, the business and data examples eight each. As scheduled the broad example meets the BA and multidisciplinary conditions, the business example meets the BA and business cluster conditions, and the data example meets the BSc and Data Science cluster conditions. The portfolio and degree examination remain student requirements.
components: Complete this 7.5 EC course before the third semester.
Complete six 7.5 EC courses at the 300 level, or four such courses and a 15 EC Research Seminar in the third year.
Choose 127.5 EC of other courses, following the applicable prerequisites.
